result:
Changed `scripts/enemy.gd` so `hit()` sets the flash shader's `amount` to 1 on that enemy's Sprite2D and tweens it to 0 over 0.2 seconds, with each enemy getting its own material so only the hit one flashes. I couldn't run the game here; the godot_review check passed with no findings.

Enemies that die from the hit are freed immediately, so the flash won't be visible on a killing blow.
